messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — we need a short checklist for the joint announce with Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant (vector DB) next month. Two asks: marketplace listing timing, and hardware partner (DGX) demo slot. Who owns the announcement cadence?
Rajesh Kumar: I can own cadence. proposed timeline: week 1 internal dry run, week 2 partner demo, week 3 customer comms + marketplace go-live. is that too tight?
Linda Ortega: timeline looks ok but legal needs 5 business days on the announcement copy. add that buffer after partner signoff.
Tom Baker: DGX demo slot: NVIDIA confirmed availability for 2024-05-14 AM PST for a technical walkthrough. we should lock by EOD if we want that date.
Maya Patel: @Tom can you confirm the scope they’ll demo? we want end-to-end ingest -> embedding -> query via our connector. also need to prove marketplace listing works with their SSO link.
Tom Baker: confirmed scope: DGX team will demo batch ingest + low-latency queries. they asked for a sample dataset and perf targets. sending sample data details in #eng-runtime.
Evan Li: For marketplace side: Snowflake listing requires completed compliance checklist + icon + 500x500 PNG. Databricks needs a listing manifest and tests in our joint CI. I can start the Snowflake form today.
Maya Patel: Awesome. Rajesh, can you own the release playbook doc and add sections: schedule, legal signoff, partner demo, marketplace artifacts, SI enablement, postmortem? Link to template: https://redwood-internal.company/docs/announce-playbook
Rajesh Kumar: Yep — I'll carve it up. quick questions: who is the SI lead for field enablement (handing over to SIs)?
Linda Ortega: SI lead will be Priya from Solutions. copying her offline. also add a rollback plan — if marketplace listing fails we should have a staged announcement to existing customers only.
Maya Patel: Good call. PartnerOps Bot: Calendar event created: "Snow/DBX/Qdrant joint demo" 2024-05-14T16:00:00Z. Attendees: Maya, Tom, Rajesh, Evan, Priya.
Tom Baker: I'll upload the sample dataset to the shared bucket by EOD and add a quick runbook snippet:
```
# sample ingest steps
gsutil cp gs://redwood-partner-samples/qdrant-demo.tar.gz /tmp
./ingest --connector snowflake --file /tmp/qdrant-demo.tar.gz --batch 1000
```
Evan Li: I'll start the Snowflake marketplace form and ping legal for the copy. tagging @Linda.
Maya Patel: Great. Action items: Rajesh - playbook doc by Tue; Tom - sample dataset + DGX scope; Evan - marketplace forms; Linda - legal clearance ETA. We'll reconvene Fri after you all update the doc. :thumbsup:
Rajesh Kumar: noted, will update and add a checklist table.
Linda Ortega: Legal ETA: Tuesday COB.
Evan Li: Started form, saved draft. will share link in thread.
Maya Patel: Perfect. Keeping this thread as the single source for coordination — please reply with short updates only. :rocket:
